choices.why: A light ash rectangular table, 140x78 cm, on slender splayed legs seats four and keeps the Nordic look airy next to the kitchenette.
Black spindle-back chairs add the requested graphic contrast and are a classic Scandinavian match for light wood.
A simple off-white dome pendant on a black cord stands out softly against the white walls and echoes the black chairs.
A low white sideboard with light greige wood fronts blends into the white wall and picks up the kitchen's wood tones.

answer.why: Light wood, white and touches of black keep the dining area simple and Nordic, in line with the kitchenette's white and light wood cabinets and the grey wood floor.
